items.title: Al Gallodoro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Oneonta, New York, December 28, 2005
items.q: I was tipped off by the bassoon player, that Mike Guerra in Philadelphia, had one, it went to the low C. I called him and he says, “Yes I’ll gladly loan it to you.”

ctx.x: Toscanini and Bernstein. © Fillius Jazz Archive -13-

Stokowski. Well let me tell you about the two conductors. They used to alternate. One week on the broadcast Toscanini conducted. The next week Stokowski. And they alternated. Now we premiered the Shostakovitch Seventh Symphony. It can be bought. It was taken off the air. And I had to borrow a special bass clarinet that went down to the low C.
